tasks.title: experience: Expo board skeleton on ScenarioStateSource
tasks.goal: A Vite + TypeScript web app whose /expo route lists tickets, plates and verdicts from a StateSource interface, backed for now by an in-browser ScenarioStateSource that replays a contracts/scenarios file. The SpacetimeDB source comes later from state's TS bindings (state-02).
acceptance: StateSource interface exposes tickets, entities, verdicts and verdict steps with subscribe callbacks shaped like the SpacetimeDB tables in contracts/state-tables.md

ScenarioStateSource loads any contracts/scenarios/*.json, replays events over time and emits verdicts from the scenario's expected entries: `npm --prefix components/experience/web test` passes a test that loads every golden scenario
/expo renders the ticket list, plates and each verdict's decision; the pass badge renders only when decision == 'pass': vitest render test passes
`npm --prefix components/experience/web run build` succeeds and CI runs build and test
Until platform ships TS types generated from contracts/schemas, a type:request is filed and types live in one file marked TEMPORARY with a link to that request
PR includes a screenshot of /expo running on a golden scenario

tasks.title: experience: ADR: web framework and app layout
tasks.goal: Pick the UI framework and layout for the tablet, chef and expo screens (one Vite app with routes is the default) and record it in a team ADR.
acceptance: docs/adr/NNNN-experience-web-framework.md proposed via PR: options considered, choice, routing, state management, test tooling (vitest), how the SpacetimeDB TS SDK and MSW mocks fit
Confirms the SpacetimeDB TypeScript SDK works with the chosen framework, citing current docs
Notes tablet constraints (touch targets, works in a browser on an iPad-class device)

tasks.title: experience: Gate state machine with ConsoleGate and MockGPIOGate
tasks.goal: A pure gate state machine (idle, pass, hold, fault) that is closed by default and fails to fault, plus the ConsoleGate and MockGPIOGate implementations of GateDriver.
acceptance: State machine table in components/experience/src/experience/gate/README.md; transitions implemented as a pure function: `uv run --package experience pytest components/experience -k gate_transitions` passes
Default state is closed (idle shows red); only an explicit pass for the plate at the pass and the ticket's current revision opens it: `pytest -k gate_opens_only_on_current_pass -m safety` passes
Verdict feed silent beyond the configured limit, or perception health stale, gives fault: `pytest -k gate_stale_fault -m safety` passes
Any exception inside the driver or state machine gives fault: `pytest -k gate_exception_fault -m safety` passes
MockGPIOGate records every show() call for assertions; ConsoleGate prints state: `pytest -k gate_fakes` passes

tasks.title: experience: ConsoleSpeaker and spoken-line formatter
tasks.goal: A Speaker fake and a formatter that turns verdicts into short spoken lines ('Hold seven', 'Seven, peanut'), dropping stale lines instead of queueing them.
acceptance: Formatter turns ticket numbers into words and produces the hold line from a verdict fixture: `uv run --package experience pytest components/experience -k voice_format` passes on contracts/fixtures/valid/verdict/*.json
ConsoleSpeaker implements Speaker.say without blocking: `pytest -k console_speaker` passes
A newer line for the same plate replaces an unspoken older one: `pytest -k speaker_drops_stale` passes

tasks.title: experience: Gate service driven by verdicts via StateClient
tasks.goal: A gate process that subscribes to verdicts through StateClient and drives GateDriver and Speaker for the plate at the pass, holding on anything other than a current-revision pass.
acceptance: Running every golden scenario through InMemoryStateClient drives MockGPIOGate to the scenario's expected decision: `pytest -k gate_service_scenarios -m safety` passes
A verdict for an older ticket revision than the current one leaves the gate holding (invariant 9): `pytest -k gate_stale_revision -m safety` passes
StateUnavailable or a silent subscription gives fault: `pytest -k gate_service_feed_loss -m safety` passes
Speaker gets 'Hold <number>' on every hold: `pytest -k gate_service_voice` passes
Runnable with ConsoleGate and ConsoleSpeaker: `uv run --package experience gate-service --fake` documented in README
out_of_scope: Real StateClient wiring beyond config (state-03 consumers)

tasks.title: experience: Tablet screen with one-tap questions and send gate
tasks.goal: The /tablet route lets a server type a note, see the parsed constraints, answer one-tap questions and send, with Send disabled until the draft is sendable.
acceptance: Uses a mock server (MSW) built from intake's components/intake/fakes/http/ examples: vitest tests run without the intake service
Send is disabled while any question is unanswered: `npm --prefix components/experience/web test -- tablet_send_gate` passes
A 409 unanswered_questions response re-shows the open questions: vitest test passes
jev_unavailable shows a manual-entry form instead of a guessed result: vitest test passes
Touch targets are at least 44 px; PR includes a screenshot

tasks.title: experience: Expo board held-plate chain view
tasks.goal: For each held plate, the expo board shows the reasons, flagged allergens and the contamination chain step by step with per-step confidence.
acceptance: Chain view renders contracts/fixtures/valid/verdict/hold-peanut.json with both steps, entities, actions and step_confidence: vitest render test passes
Every reason code in verdict.schema.json has a human label: vitest test enumerates the enum
Plates whose latest verdict is for an older ticket revision show 'rechecking', not pass: vitest test passes
PR includes a screenshot running on the knife-carries-peanut-to-plate scenario

tasks.title: experience: Connect expo board to SpacetimeDB TS bindings
tasks.goal: Add a SpacetimeDB-backed StateSource using the TS bindings generated by state, with live subscriptions, while ScenarioStateSource stays for tests and demos.
acceptance: SpacetimeDB source subscribes to ticket, ticket_constraint, entity, entity_risk, verdict and verdict_step and fills the same store: unit tests with the generated bindings mocked pass
Source is selected by config or URL parameter; the default in tests is ScenarioStateSource
Connection loss shows a visible 'feed lost' banner and never leaves stale PASS badges on screen: vitest test passes
PR body includes output from a manual run against a local SpacetimeDB set up per state's README

tasks.title: experience: Chef confirmation screen
tasks.goal: The /chef route lists open chef confirmations for unclear bin ingredients and lets the chef pick allergen units, calling intake's /v1/profiles/bins/{id}/confirm.
acceptance: Lists open confirmations from the StateSource (chef_confirmation table) with bin label and ingredient: vitest test passes on seeded data
Submitting calls the confirm endpoint (MSW mock) with the chosen allergen_unit_ids; 'none of these' is an explicit choice: vitest test passes
Allergen choices come from contracts/allergen_units.json, never hardcoded: vitest test passes
PR includes a screenshot

tasks.title: experience: 'Start ticket' button calling perception
tasks.goal: A cook-facing 'start ticket' control that calls perception's POST /v1/plates/start and shows clear errors when no plate or several plates are at the plating spot.
acceptance: Calls POST /v1/plates/start with the ticket_id against a mock server: vitest test passes
409 no_plate_at_spot and 409 multiple_plates_at_spot show distinct messages and nothing is assumed bound: vitest test passes
A type:request is filed with perception for the CORS policy needed for browser calls to the Pi

tasks.title: experience: Spike: verify Cartesia Sonic for gate voice
tasks.goal: Document how Cartesia Sonic would be called for short gate lines: auth, streaming vs batch, latency, audio output on the Pi, cost, and offline fallback.
acceptance: components/experience/docs/sonic-spike.md answers each point, citing sources; unverified claims are marked
Adapter sketch keeps the Speaker signature unchanged and explains how stale lines are dropped
Owner questions (keys, voice choice) posted on the issue with status:needs-human if needed
